dedupe_keys.name: donnees de frequentation detaillees du reseau star

description: STAR publishes an index of detailed ridership files for the Rennes network. The described files distinguish operating day, fifteen-minute interval, stop, municipality, line, direction and ridership. Their metadata lists file links, sizes, coverage dates and publication dates. These counts provide demand observations for transit simulation and capacity studies. The provider describes monthly publication with a two-month delay and one year of rolling history. Current topology can differ from the historical network that generated the counts. Line 9000 represents park-and-ride activity; stop identifiers 65501 and 9999 indicate ridership that could not be located. The source repeats column number 8 in its description. Files were not fetched, so actual date coverage and missing values remain unverified. Coverage follows the provider-described Rennes network. Public catalogue pages and JSON metadata are free to access. The source specifies ODbL licensing. Data rows and export bodies were not fetched; distribution usability remains unverified. Related daily aggregate ridership omits this stop and time-band detail.
